verses.greek: εἶδεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὸν Ναθαναὴλ ἐρχόμενον πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ λέγει περὶ αὐτοῦ· Ἴδε ἀληθῶς Ἰσραηλίτης ἐν ᾧ δόλος οὐκ ἔστιν.
verses.dgt: Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him and said about him, “Look—truly an Israelite in whom there is no deceit!”
verses.literal: Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him and says concerning him, Look, truly an Israelite in whom deceit is not.
notes: δόλος means deceit/guile; the wording may evoke Jacob/Israel imagery.

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῷ Ναθαναήλ· Πόθεν με γινώσκεις; ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Πρὸ τοῦ σε Φίλιππον φωνῆσαι ὄντα ὑπὸ τὴν συκῆν εἶδόν σε.
verses.dgt: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, while you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”
verses.literal: Nathanael says to him, From where do you know me? Jesus answered and said to him, Before Philip called you, being under the fig tree I saw you.

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ὅτι εἶπόν σοι ὅτι εἶδόν σε ὑποκάτω τῆς συκῆς πιστεύεις; μείζω τούτων ὄψῃ.
verses.dgt: Jesus answered him, “Do you believe because I told you that I saw you under the fig tree? You will see greater things than these.”
verses.literal: Jesus answered and said to him, Because I said to you that I saw you under the fig tree, do you believe? Greater things than these you will see.

verses.greek: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὄψεσθε τὸν οὐρανὸν ἀνεῳγότα καὶ τοὺς ἀγγέλους τοῦ θεοῦ ἀναβαίνοντας καὶ καταβαίνοντας ἐπὶ τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.
verses.dgt: And he said to him, “Truly, truly, I tell you: you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of Man.”
verses.literal: And he says to him, Truly truly I say to you-all, you-all will see heaven having been opened and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of Man.
notes: The Greek pronoun and verb are plural: Jesus says “you-all” will see.
